caption: The drawing depicts a puppet with a human-like figure positioned centrally on a plain beige background. The puppet has a large pinkish face with exaggerated facial features, including a pronounced nose, arched black eyebrows, and a thick black mustache and beard. The puppet wears a bright red hat with white spots and a matching red long-sleeved shirt. Around its neck, there is a loosely-tied green scarf. The puppet’s lower part is covered by a skirt featuring a dark green and black floral or geometric pattern on a red background. The puppet extends both arms outward, with its hands rendered in a simplified, blocky manner. The edges of the drawing are bordered by a brown rectangular frame that is uneven in thickness.
title: Puppet: Pirate
